children.value: > Fact From Story When discussing Uber’s results internally, our vibe was that it is a very profitable and healthy company today, albeit one that is not growing as fast as the market had hoped.

> > Fact From Story the fact that Uber’s share price is up as we write this indicates that investors are content thus far to excuse the small Q3 misses and keep their eyes more focused on its year-over-year improvements and forward guidance.
> > Commonsense Knowledge Investors are more likely to invest in companies they expect to do well.
> Commonsense Knowledge Healthy and profitable companies are good.
